comment: Read automatically by depcheck, which update-npm-deps.ps1 runs at the end of every sweep to report declared
dependencies nothing appears to use. depcheck cannot see a package that is only invoked as a CLI from a script,
named as a string in a config, or pulled in by a compiler option, so each name below is a verified false positive
with the reference that proves it. Because this file exists, anything depcheck still reports fails the sweep -
so a genuinely unused dependency cannot be waved through, and a new entry here needs its reason recorded.
The key is `ignores`, depcheck's CLI-style rc name; `ignoreMatches` is the API-only spelling and is silently

@commitlint/config-conventional - extended by name (a string in the commitlint config's `extends`), never imported - either directly, or through obsidian-dev-utils' script-utils/commitlint-config, which extends it without declaring it.

@types/markdown-it - nothing here imports markdown-it, but markdownlint-rule-relative-links is built on that parser (it refuses to run without a markdownItFactory) and its src/index.d.ts imports it untyped. tsconfig.json sets skipLibCheck false, so that .d.ts is type-checked and TS7016s without these types.
cspell - run as a CLI by scripts/spellcheck.ts, configured by cspell.json.
czg - run as a CLI by scripts/commit.ts.
dprint - run as a CLI by the format scripts, configured by dprint.json.
husky - installed by scripts/prepare.ts; the hooks in .husky/ are its output.
linkinator - run as a CLI, named as a string by the markdown lint helper.
markdownlint-cli2 - run as a CLI by the lint:md scripts, configured by .markdownlint-cli2.mjs.
nano-staged - .husky/pre-commit runs it; configured by scripts/nano-staged-config.ts.
type-fest - referenced by the `"type-fest": "$type-fest"` overrides shorthand, which resolves its version against this declaration.
